item.title: Local roundup: Ballhawks win gold; St. Croix turns pro; Bechard lauded; Konecny stars
item.description: The Chatham 13U Ballhawks Blue won gold medals at the Ontario Volleyball Association’s McGregor Cup 13U girls tournament Saturday in Sarnia.

item.description: Chatham-Kent police opened applications for the Citizen’s Police Academy

item.title: Man charged after knife wielded in clash: Chatham-Kent police
item.description: A man faces charges after people at a Chatham business were threatened with a knife during a clash Sunday, Chatham-Kent police say.

item.title: Detroit’s $2.2B RenCen overhaul to reshape skyline long-familiar to Windsor
item.description: RenCen twin tower tear-down and overhaul will create new 6-acre public park, promenades, uninterrupted access between Detroit downtown and waterfront.

item.title: Chatham Maroons' Sammy DiBlasi wins OHL award
item.description: Sammy DiBlasi likes his schedule full and his head clear.

item.title: Woman charged after $600K fraud at Delaware Nation must pay for lawyer
item.description: A woman charged after more than $600,000 went missing from Delaware Nation at Moraviantown will need to find and pay for her own lawyer, court heard.

item.title: 'High-level drug trafficker' sentenced to 16 1/2 years in prison
